subject: Founders stipend + sandbox credits — consolidation & convert-to-dedicated ask
messages:
From: Evan Reed <evan@nimbusfoundry.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Founders stipend + sandbox credits — consolidation & convert-to-dedicated ask

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Quick follow up as we start prepping our internal budget:

We have two promotional buckets with Redwood that came through different programs — a $12k founder stipend (one-time) and $8k sandbox credits (usage). Founders at Nimbus are asking if we can: 1) merge the two balances into a single pool (so we can draw down flexibly across early infra & embeddings usage), and 2) add a path to convert any remaining promo balance at a later milestone (e.g., after reaching 50k monthly tokens) into a one-time credit that can be applied toward a 3-month discounted Dedicated commitment (we'd pay committed $/month but get a one-time promo top-up to reduce month 1).

We understand there are accounting and legal constraints — just trying to see whether product/billing supports a consolidated promo pool + a conversion trigger. If it's possible, happy to share numbers and milestone language. If not, appreciate a quick no so we can plan alternatives.

Would love a brief proposal/ops path if feasible.

Best,
Evan Reed
Founder & CTO
Nimbus Foundry

--
Nimbus Foundry — building tooling for dataset versioning
From: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founders stipend + sandbox credits — consolidation & convert-to-dedicated ask

Hi Evan —

Thanks for the clear description — this is a reasonable ask and one we've had from a few cohorts. I'll loop in Ben from Partnerships (billing/ops) and Irene on legal to outline constraints and an operational path.

Quick asks for us to model options:
- Current balances (you listed $12k + $8k — can you confirm the promo IDs or the program names so we can match in billing)
- Target milestone for conversion (you suggested 50k monthly tokens — is that target net tokens or per-user?)
- Preferred conversion: do you want a one-time allocation as a reduction to month 1 of a Dedicated commit, or a pre-paid credit on your account that the billing team applies toward the first invoice?

If you can reply with the promo IDs and preferred conversion language, Ben will sketch a conservative ops flow and we can move to a short term sheet if legal approves.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference runtime
From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Evan Reed <evan@nimbusfoundry.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founders stipend + sandbox credits — consolidation & convert-to-dedicated ask

Evan / Laura —

Thanks — quick operational note and a proposed conservative approach. I attached a short spreadsheet (billing_calc.xlsx) and a draft term sheet (term_sheet_draft.pdf) to show numbers and two paths. High level:

Option A — Pool + One-time conversion credit
- We merge the two promos into a single promotional balance on the account (billing ops action).
- At your milestone trigger (50k net tokens for 30 days), we issue a one-time conversion credit equal to X% of remaining promo balance, to be applied to the first invoice of a 3-month Dedicated commitment.
- Pros: simple for founders, preserves promo accounting.
- Cons: conversion reduces promotional liability but we need a minimum committed spend to qualify.

Option B — Pool + Prepaid invoice credit conversion
- Merge promos into a pool, then upon milestone we convert the remaining balance into a prepaid account credit applied across the next N invoices (ops-run).
- Pros: simpler legal treatment as a prepayment; easier to apply if you convert outside of a Dedicated product change.
- Cons: less targeted to promotional upsell economics.

Operational & accounting constraints to flag:
- We cannot convert credits to cash refunds. Must remain as account-level credits.
- Some promos are program-restricted (e.g., cohort-only) and cannot be re-applied to Dedicated SKUs. We need the promo IDs to verify.
- Tax/financial treatment depends on whether the credit is recorded as contra-revenue or a marketing expense for the program owner. Irene, attaching for legal/accounting review.

If Nimbus can send the promo IDs (or forward the original welcome email), I can run a verification and produce final numbers in the attached spreadsheet. If agreeable, next step is a short 1-page addendum (term sheet) and a 7–10 day ops turnaround.

Next steps checklist:
- Evan: share promo IDs / welcome emails (or give me billing contact access)
- Evan: confirm whether conversion should target "first invoice" or "spread over 3 invoices"
- Laura/Ben: finalize which option (A or B) we recommend
- Irene: confirm legal/accounting constraints and any required sign-off

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call this week if helpful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: billing_calc.xlsx (pro-forma), term_sheet_draft.pdf (1-pg sketch)
From: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, Evan Reed <evan@nimbusfoundry.com>
Cc: finance@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Founders stipend + sandbox credits — consolidation & convert-to-dedicated ask

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear framing. From a legal & accounting perspective the conservative path is Option B (convert to a prepaid account credit) because it maintains promo accounting continuity and minimizes SKU reclassification risk. A few items we need before we can approve operational changes:

1) Promo IDs or the original program names so finance can map liabilities to the marketing ledger.
2) Confirmation from Nimbus that they accept the credit will remain non-refundable and only applicable to Redwood invoices.
3) If this credit will be used to offset a Dedicated commitment, we need a brief clause in the addendum: "Conversion credit may be applied to invoices for Redwood Dedicated SKUs only; any unused credit remains account-level and non-refundable."

I suggest the following workflow:
- Ops merges promos into a single account-level promo pool (billing action)
- On trigger, ops converts remaining balance into a prepaid credit record (memo on invoice)
- Finance posts the credit, legal signs the one-page addendum, and we route to DocuSign (Iris will prepare the payload)

Laura / Ben — once Evan provides IDs, finance will need 3–5 business days to reconcile and ops will need ~7 business days to execute the merge + conversion flows. Evan — if that timeline works, we can proceed.

Irene Choi
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
